text_block_list.text:
Now, try putting what I've told you into
practice.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Remember, only accelerate at the last
second,
once you're coming out of the
turn.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Right! I'll give it my best shot!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Look at her go. It's as if she's a whole
new runner
now. And it's all thanks to
your guidance.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
My guidance? Haha. Well, don't stop
there.
Please heap on all the praise you
can.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
My apologies. To tell the truth, I was
merely
parroting the advice my trainer
gave to me.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I thought he would appreciate it if I
passed on
your praise.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I thought she would appreciate it if I
passed on
your praise.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Haha, I have to say it's rather gratifying
to see
one's own trainer praised.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
